scope: Server-side dry-run admission of one synthetic hostPath Pod under an unlabeled namespace and the same namespace enforcing Kubernetes v1.36 Pod Security Admission Baseline, plus a permitted emptyDir Pod dry-run. No Pod is persisted or run. No host path is created, mounted, or read. Does not test production-wide namespace coverage, admission configuration, a real infrastructure exception, policy-engine deployment, exception-register governance, or audit delivery. The supplemental case-owned ValidatingAdmissionPolicy checks one synthetic approval record and request shape; it does not establish production exception outcomes. PSA audit labels are set, but API audit events are not collected or checked.
